text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD). The chest X-ray findings of hyperinflation and a flattened diaphragm are classic signs of air trapping, which typically presents with persistent cough and shortness of breath. Do you have a history of long-term exposure to smoke, dust, or other lung irritants?
